title: Add RAG edge 'SlimPlay' Wasm runner with live debug probes and telemetry presets
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Motivation: make RAG developer onboarding realistic for constrained edge environments (IoT gateways, offline kiosks, on-device inference via Wasm runtimes). This quickstart introduces a compact 'SlimPlay' Wasm runner that demonstrates a small-footprint RAG pipeline: lightweight index retrieval, streamed token generation fallback, and an experiment-friendly probe surface for live debugging and telemetry.

What this PR adds (single artifact quickstart):
- slimplay/runner: minimal Wasm-compatible runner (Rust + wasm-pack) that hosts a tiny retrieval layer, a configurable model adapter stub, and a stepwise controller for tool calls.
- slimplay/devcontainer: local devcontainer and CI shim to exercise the Wasm artifact in a Node-based harness.
- slimplay/docs: step-by-step quickstart on running on-device RAG, authoring compact indexes, and using the debug-probes. Includes a short 'how to evaluate cost vs latency' checklist.
- slimplay/telemetry-presets: lightweight opentelemetry config and a compact set of telemetry probes (latency, cache-hit, prefix-kv reuse, memory high-water) suitable for constrained devices.
- CI: smoke integration test that runs the Wasm artifact in a headless Node runner and asserts that the retrieval+generate loop completes with expected structured output.

Design notes:
- The runner intentionally avoids heavy dependencies and shows a pattern for incremental index loading and prefix caching to keep memory under a 150MB budget.
- Debug probes are implemented as opt-in hooks with small JSON snapshots (not full traces) so teams can adopt them without large trace retention costs.
- Telemetry presets are opinionated: prioritize token latency and cache reuse rates over token-level traces.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add SlimPlay runner and minimal adapter stubs
- [x] Add docs quickstart and runbook examples
- [x] Add devcontainer and CI smoke test
- [x] Add telemetry presets and a sample visualization dashboard snippet
- [x] Review and sign off from infra/telemetry

Related work: references ENG-12241 (edge inference playbooks), docsite issue PM-4410 for a compact quickstart section.

Merging notes: squashed into a single commit to keep quickstart history tidy. See commits for development history and the CI run details below.
